reserves.name: frxUSD savings vault shares
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Frax Finance and frxUSD reserve venues

reserveReview.rationale: Frax documents sfrxUSD as an ERC-4626-like token fully redeemable for frxUSD at an increasing exchange rate. Its benchmark strategy can rotate among carry trades, AMOs, DeFi venues, and short-dated Treasury-bill strategies; the reserve envelope therefore retains one 100% frxUSD dependency while leaving strategy allocation dynamic.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The frxUSD dependency is identified at 100%, but the current benchmark-yield venue, strategy allocation, and available redemption liquidity are dynamic.

providers.name: Frax-approved AMO, DeFi, carry-trade, and Treasury venues

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Frax identifies the vault and governance-approved strategy venues but does not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation, or current venue shares.
